summary: Reliance Global Group filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) to disclose that on June 2, 2026, it received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), following 10 consecutive business days of closing bid prices at or above $1.00 from May 18 to June 1, 2026. This resolves the deficiency that triggered a prior December 12, 2025, notice. The company issued a press release on June 3, 2026. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
